newsitem.title: USA: Stocks bow to more profit-taking.
newsitem.headline: Stocks bow to more profit-taking.

text.p: Blue-chip stocks fell Thursday as the market was rattled by a second straight day of stiff selling after its recent rise to record highs.
Based on early and unofficial data, the Dow Jones industrial average closed down 27.05 points at 7,330.18.
But in the broader market, advancing issues led declines 14-10 on moderate volume of 463 million shares on the New York Stock Exchange.
